site.support.contact.body: We answer every message. Please include your iPhone model and iOS version — it makes most problems obvious straight away.
site.support.contact.title: Write to us
site.support.data.body: On your iPhone, and nowhere else. Settings → Export as CSV gives you a copy; Settings → Delete all data removes everything at once. Deleting the app removes the rest.
site.support.data.title: Where is my data?
site.support.heading: Support
site.support.lede: Sunfold has no account and no sign-in, so there is nothing to recover and no password to reset. If something is wrong, write and describe what you saw.
site.support.subscription.body: Subscriptions live on your Apple ID, not with us. Open the App Store, tap your photo, then Subscriptions to change or cancel. Restoring a purchase on a new device: Sunfold Pro → Restore.
site.support.subscription.title: Managing a subscription
site.tagline: A calm intermittent fasting timer for iPhone. Everything stays on your device.
site.terms.heading: Terms of Use
site.terms.lede: Sunfold is licensed under Apple's Standard End User Licence Agreement, the default licence for apps distributed on the App Store.
site.terms.pricing.body: Sunfold is free to use with the 16:8 schedule and the last seven days of history. Sunfold Pro is available monthly, yearly, or as a single lifetime payment. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends.
site.terms.pricing.title: Subscriptions
